paragraphs: R' Levi bar Fanti — Kohelet Rabbah 8:3; see the entry Levi bar Buta.[^1][^2]

notes.text: קה״ר is conventionally Kohelet Rabbah; פ״ח-ג gives chapter 8, section 3, without independent named-edition verification of the exact section.

Fanti (also transliterable Panti) and the cross-reference’s Buta remain different supplied forms. The cross-reference alone does not establish identity. The abbreviated title remains R'; no title is imported into the bare target.
